Notes on writing scientific papers clearly, from the whole paper down to a single
word. They combine the guides I learned from with the research that tests them,
and every rule carries a label for how strong its evidence is.

[Experimental]{.ev .ev-e} tested by changing a text and measuring readers ·
[Correlational]{.ev .ev-c} linked to citations, not proven to cause them ·
[Descriptive]{.ev .ev-d} a trend in the literature ·
[Expert]{.ev .ev-g} advice from experienced writers and editors, untested
